name: Mutant Extremists Target U.S. Senators!
setup_text: Place 6 Senator tokens (Civilian) as shown on the map below.
scoring_text: Players score 1 VP per character they control holding a Senator during the Cleanup Phase.
special_rules:
Interact (Senator): Pick up this Senator. A character can hold only 1 Senator at a time.

A character holding a Senator can make only 1 move action per Turn.

name: Survivors Search for Safe Shelters
setup_text: Place 3 Shelter tokens (Point of Interest) as shown on the map below.
scoring_text: Players score 1 VP for each Shelter they Secure during the Cleanup Phase.
special_rules: When a character Contesting a Shelter is targeted by an attack, 1 other allied character that is also Contesting that Shelter may spend 1 POWER. If it does, the defender adds 1 die to its defense roll. A character can add dice to its roll in this way only once per Turn.

name: Salvaged Supplies Fuel Resistance Efforts
setup_text: Place 2 Supply tokens (Asset) as shown on the map below.
scoring_text: Players score 2 VP for each character they control that is holding Supplies during the Cleanup Phase.
special_rules:
Interact (Supplies): If another allied non-Grunt character is Contesting these Supplies, pick them up. Supplies are Limited.

When a character that is holding Supplies ends its Activation, if it is not within RANGE 2 of another allied character, it drops those Supplies.

When Supplies would be moved to another character, they are dropped instead.

name: Evidence of Experimental Soldiers Exposed!
setup_text: Place 3 Unexhausted Server tokens (Source) as shown on the map below. Set aside 3 Evidence tokens (Asset).
scoring_text: Players score 1 VP for each character they control that is holding an Evidence during the Cleanup Phase.
special_rules:
Interact (Server): Flip this Server and pick up an Evidence from it. Evidence are Limited. A character cannot Interact with a Server while it is holding an Evidence.

When a character holding an Evidence is attacked, it may reroll 1 of its defense dice.

Upload: During the Cleanup Phase, remove all Evidence from the Game and Flip each Exhausted Server.

name: Sentinel Schematics Sabotaged!
setup_text: Place 4 Unexhausted Factory tokens (Source) as shown on the map below. Set aside 4 Nanite tokens (Asset).
scoring_text: Players score 1 VP for each character they control that is holding a Nanite during the Cleanup Phase.
special_rules:
Interact (Factory): Flip this Factory and pick up a Nanite from it. Nanites are Limited. A character cannot Interact with a Factory while it is holding a Nanite.

When a character holding a Nanite attacks a character within RANGE 2, add 1 die to that attack roll.

Disintegrate: During the Cleanup Phase, remove all Nanites from the Game and Flip each Exhausted Factory.

name: Power Overload! Factory Goes Up in Flames
setup_text: Place 4 Power Conduit tokens (Point of Interest) as shown on the map below.
scoring_text: Players score 1 VP for each Power Conduit they Secure during the Cleanup Phase.
special_rules:
During the Score VPs part of the Cleanup Phase, if a player is Securing 2 or more Power Conduits and at least 2 of those Power Conduits are not within RANGE 5 of each other, that player scores 1 additional VP.

During the Cleanup Phase, for each Power Conduit, if 3 or more characters are within RANGE 1 of that Power Conduit, each of those characters suffers 1 WOUND.

name: Lockdown! Security Systems Stymie Breakout
setup_text: Place 4 Prison Block tokens (Point of Interest) as shown on the map below.
scoring_text: Players score 1 VP for each Prison Block they Secure during the Cleanup Phase.
special_rules:
Characters Contest Prison Blocks within RANGE 2 instead of RANGE 1.

During the Cleanup Phase, remove all WOUND tokens from Prison Blocks. Then roll a die. Put a WOUND token on the Prison Block marked with the matching result on the map below. The unmarked Prison Block matches the BLANK result. A Prison Block with a WOUND token on it cannot be Interacted with, Contested, or Secured.

name: Unexpected Guests Crash Royal Wedding
setup_text: Place 4 Guest tokens (Civilian) as shown on the map below.
scoring_text: Players score 1 VP for each character they control that is holding a Guest during the Cleanup Phase.
special_rules:
Interact (Guest): Pick up this Guest. A character can hold only 1 Guest at a time.

During the Power Phase, starting with the player with Priority, for each character that player controls that is not within RANGE 2 of a Secure objective that is also holding a Guest, the controlling player's opponent chooses a Secure objective. That character is Pushed toward the chosen Secure objective SHORT. The opposing player resolves this Push.

name: Infinity Formula Goes Missing!
setup_text: Place 4 Serum Canister tokens (Point of Interest) as shown on the map below.
scoring_text: Players score 1 VP for each Serum Canister they Secure during the Cleanup Phase.
special_rules: During the Power Phase, characters Contesting a Serum Canister gain 1 POWER.

name: Super-Powered Scoundrels Form Sinister Syndicate
setup_text: Place 5 Ambush tokens (Point of Interest) as shown on the map below.
scoring_text: Players score 1 VP for each Ambush they Secure during the Cleanup Phase.
special_rules: Characters Contesting an Ambush have Cover from characters not Contesting the same Ambush.

name: Research Station Attacked!
setup_text: Place 1 Researcher token (Civilian) and 2 Evac Points (Assets) as shown on the map below.
scoring_text: A player scores 2 VPs if they are securing the Researcher during the Cleanup Phase. Then they score 1 additional VP if the Researcher is within RANGE 1 of their Evac Point.
special_rules:
During the Power Phase, the Researcher may move. If a player is securing the Researcher, they may Place it within RANGE 2 of its current location.

The Evac Point farthest from a player's battlefield edge is their Evac Point.

name: Demons downtown! Has our comeuppance come due?
setup_text: Place 3 Flaming Portal tokens (Point of Interest) as shown on the map below.
scoring_text: Players score 1 VP for each Flaming Portal they are Securing during the Cleanup Phase.
special_rules: During the Power Phase, characters within RANGE 1 of a Flaming Portal gain the Incinerate special condition.

name: Gamma Wave Sweeps Across Midwest
setup_text: Place 3 Gamma Shelter tokens (Point of Interest) as shown on the map below.
scoring_text: Players score 1 VP for Securing their Close, 1 VP for the Mid, and 2 VPs for Securing their Far Gamma Shelter during the Cleanup Phase.
special_rules:
during the Cleanup Phase, each character that is not within RANGE 2 of a Gamma Shelter suffers 1 WOUND.

The Gamma Shelter closest to a player's battlefield edge is their Close Shelter. The Gamma Shelter in the center is both player's Mid Shelter. The Gamma Shelter farthest from a pleyr's battlefield edge is their Far Shelter.

name: Intrusions Open Across city as seals collapse
setup_text: Place 3 Dark Portal tokens (Point of Interest) as shown on the map below.
scoring_text: Players score 1 VP for each Dark Portal they Secure during the Cleanup Phase.
special_rules: Interact (Dark Portal): This character drops all objective tokens it is holding. Then roll 1 die. If the result is a CRIT, WILD, HIT, or DEFENSE, Place this character within RANGE 1 of another Dark Portal. Otherwise, the opposing player Places this character within RANGE 1 of another Dark Portal.

name: Guardians Save Shi'ar Empress in Style
setup_text: Place 4 Security Terminal tokens (Point of Interest) as shown on the map below.
scoring_text: Players score 1 VP for each Secury Terminal they Control during the Cleanup Phase.
special_rules:
Interact (Security Terminal): Roll 3 dice. If the roll contains more CRIT, WILD, or HIT results than the number of Healthy enemy characters Contesting this Security Terminal, you now Control this Security Terminal.

If a character is holding one or more Extract objective tokens, it may reroll 1 die when interacting with a Security Terminal.

name: Spider-Infected Invade Manhattan
setup_text: Place 5 Spider-Infected tokens (Civilian) as shown on the map below.
scoring_text: Players score 1 VP for each Spider-Infected held by a character they control during the Cleanup Phase.
special_rules:
Interact (Spider-Infected): Pick up the Spider-Infected. A character can hold only 1 Spider-Infected at a time.

During the Power Phase, starting with the player with Priority players roll 1 die for each character they control holding a Spider-Infected. If the results is a CRIT, WILD, or HIT, that character Advances SHORT before rolling for the next character. The opposing player resolves this Advance.

name: Skrulls Infiltrate World Leadership
setup_text: Place 4 Skrull Agent tokens (Civilian) as shown on the map below.
scoring_text: Players score 1 VP for each Skrull Agent held by a character they control during the Cleanup Phase.
special_rules: Interac (Skrull Agent): Pick up this Skrull Agent. A character can hold only 1 Skrull Agent at a time. Then roll dice equal to this character's PHYSICAL defense. If the result does not contain one or more CRIT or WILD results, the opposing players Pushes this character SHORT.

name: Struggle for the Cube Continues
setup_text: Place 5 Cosmic Cube Fragment tokens (Asset) as shown on the map below.
scoring_text: Players score 1 VP for each Cosmic Cube Fragment held by a character they control during the Cleanup Phase.
special_rules:
Interact (Cosmic Cube Fragment): Pick up this Cosmic Cube Fragment.

During the Cleanup Phase, each character suffers 1 WOUND for each Cosmic Cube Fragment it is holding. Character gain 1 POWER for each WOUND they suffered this way.

name: Paranoia Pummels Populace!
setup_text: Place 4 Disturbance tokens (Asset) as shown on the map below.
scoring_text: Players score 1 VP for each Disturbance a character they control is holding during the Cleanup Phase.
special_rules:
Interact (Disturbance): Pick up this Disturbance. A character can hold only 1 Disturbance at a time.

When a character picks up a Disturbance, if there is not another allied character within RANGE 2 of it, it suffers 1 WOUND.

During the Cleanup Phase, if one or more characters holding a Disturbance are within RANGE 2 of another allied character, thos characters' controlling players score 1 VP.

name: Fear Grips World as "Worthy" Terrorize Cities
setup_text: Place 4 Celestial Hammer Tokens (Asset) as shown on the map below.
scoring_text: Players score 1 VP for each Celestial Hammer held by a character they control during the Cleanup Phase.
special_rules:
Interact (Celestial Hammer): Pick up this Celestial Hammer.

Characters add 1 die to their attack rolls for each Celestial Hammer they are holding. Characters holding one or more Celestial Hammers must pay 1 POWER before playing a Team Tactic Card.
